title: Cellular Operators Association of India v. Telecom Regulatory Authority of India

content.caseIdentity: Cellular Operators Association of India v. Telecom Regulatory Authority of India, (2016) 7 SCC 703
content.facts: The Court reviewed regulations made by a statutory regulator.
questionsBeforeCourt: How does judicial review operate against expert regulatory subordinate legislation?
content.ratioDecidendi: Regulatory expertise does not immunise subordinate legislation from judicial review; regulations must remain within statutory authority and constitutional limits.
content.holding: The Court scrutinised the regulator's regulations against the governing statute.
content.relevance: Use for modern regulatory rulemaking and judicial control.
